description: Provide one pure deterministic quote-discount allocation model shared across runtime consumers.
Allocate item-targeted discounts only to the matching selected base item.
Allocate service-targeted discounts across every selected matching service item.
Allocate whole-quote discounts across every selected base item.
Split mixed-cadence allocations proportionally by non-negative base amount.
Conserve integer cents with deterministic largest-remainder rounding and display-order tie-breaking.
Exclude optional unselected items from discount bases and allocations.
Resolve removed, unmatched, and zero-value targets to a zero allocation.
Cap resolved discounts at their eligible base so grouped totals cannot become negative.
Keep persisted discount amounts positive and preserve quote-level subtraction semantics.
Use shared allocation semantics for live draft/editor totals and target edits.
Use shared allocation semantics when recalculating and saving quote financials.
Derive allocations for existing persisted discounts with false or null cadence fields.
Subtract allocated reductions from recurring and one-time adapter summaries exactly once.
Preserve service, product, location, phase, and general line-item consumer compatibility.
Render corrected grouped totals through standard Grouped Quote preview and PDF.
Render corrected grouped totals through duplicated or custom equivalent template ASTs without rewriting them.
Document rendered evidence and the prior positive-discount group-sum discrepancy.
